chunks: And when Luqman said to his son, while he was advising him,
"O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allah. Indeed, association [with him] is great injustice."

key_terms.لَظُلْمٌ عَظِيمٌ: A great injustice, describing the nature of shirk
key_terms.لُقْمَانُ: Luqman, the wise figure known for his counsel

ai.seo_question: What is Luqman's advice to his son regarding shirk?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is often cited as the foundational text for parental education (tarbiyah), emphasizing that monotheism (tawhid) is the core principle passed from father to son. The designation of shirk as 'zulm' (injustice) is interpreted not merely as a theological error but as a self-inflicted harm, where the soul is deprived of its rightful due to the Creator. This context underscores the practical implication that avoiding shirk is the prerequisite for all other virtues in a believer's life.

en.ahmedali: "O son, do not associate any one with God. To associate others with God is a grievous wrong."
en.ahmedraza: And remember when Luqman said to his son, and he used to advise him, “
O my son! Never ascribe anything as a partner to Allah; indeed ascribing partners to Him is a tremendous injustice.”
en.arberry: And when Lokman said to his son, admonishing him,
'O my son, do not associate others with God; to associate others with God is a mighty wrong.
en.daryabadi: And recall what time Luqman said unto his son, while he was exhorting him:
O my son! associate not aught with Allah; verily this associating is surely a tremendous wrong.
en.hilali: And (remember) when Luqman said to his son when he was advising him:
"O my son! Join not in worship others with Allah. Verily! Joining others in worship with Allah is a great Zulm (wrong) indeed.
en.itani: When Luqman said to his son, as he advised him, “
O my son, do not associate anything with God, for idolatry is a terrible wrong.”
en.maududi: And call to mind when Luqman said to his son while exhorting him:
“My son, do not associate others with Allah in His Divinity. Surely, associating others with Allah in His Divinity is a mighty wrong.”
en.mubarakpuri: And when Luqman said to his son when he was advising him:
"O my son! Join not in worship others with Allah. Verily, joining others in worship with Allah is a great Zulm (wrong) indeed."
en.pickthall: And (remember) when Luqman said unto his son, when he was exhorting him:
O my dear son! Ascribe no partners unto Allah. Lo! to ascribe partners (unto Him) is a tremendous wrong -
en.qarai: When Luqman said to his son, as he advised him:
‘O my son! Do not ascribe any partners to Allah. Polytheism is indeed a great injustice.’
en.qaribullah: And when Lokman said to his son, in warning:
'My son, associate none with Allah, to associate others with Allah is a tremendous wrong'
en.sahih: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Luqman said to his son while he was instructing him,
"O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allah. Indeed, association [with him] is great injustice."
en.sarwar: Luqman advised his son telling him,
"My son, do not consider anything equal to God, for it is the greatest injustice."
en.shakir: And when Luqman said to his son while he admonished him:
O my son! do not associate aught with Allah; most surely polytheism is a grievous iniquity--
en.transliteration: Waith qala luqmanu liibnihi wahuwa yaAAithuhu
ya bunayya la tushrik biAllahi inna alshshirka lathulmun AAatheemun
en.wahiduddin: Luqman said to his son, counselling him, "
My son, do not associate anything with God. Associating others with Him is a terrible wrong."
en.yusufali: Behold, Luqman said to his son by way of instruction:
"O my son! join not in worship (others) with Allah: for false worship is indeed the highest wrong-doing."
